description: Create, rename, delete, or write Discord bot file content. Destructive actions require confirm=true. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

expectedRevision.description: `revision` returned when the file was read. With action `write` the write is refused (409 file_changed) when the file changed since; re-read and retry.

serviceId.description: ID of the Discord bot: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_discord_bots (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

name: mutate_discord_bot_file
title: Edit Discord Bot File
